reason: Primary function is an interactive desktop-style DSH web UI extension: it provides a persistent EVA Unit-01 visual pet with session-driven HUD state, animation actions, and sound feedback. Evidence from the README and manifest shows it is fundamentally a user-facing interface/overlay plugin rather than a developer-only utility, with optional local audio override support and test/audit tooling for behavior validation.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web GUI 中提供可拖拽的 EVA 初号机桌宠覆盖层，并依据会话状态显示 HUD 与联动动作、音效。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a draggable EVA Unit-01 desktop pet overlay to the DSH web GUI, showing HUD status driven by live session state with action and sound feedback.

capabilities: Renders a draggable overlay-based visual companion in the DSH web UI.
Drives HUD/mood behavior from live session-state inputs such as running calls, tool results, and errors.
Plays action-linked synthesized sound effects and can play user-supplied local audio samples.
Adds host-side read-only audio-serving endpoints for manifest/file discovery.
Provides built-in debug/test hooks and extensive automated validation scripts for state, animation, and audio wiring.

reasons.code: README describes plugin UI placement in shell.overlay with portal to body, z-index/pointer-events handling, drag behavior, and dozens of action animations.
README documents mood and HUD derivation from session snapshots (running sessions, tool calls, errors, tool-result nodes), indicating runtime session data consumption.
README T20 details host routes /eva01-audio/manifest and /eva01-audio/file as read-only endpoints backed by a local user directory.
package.json exposes client entrypoint for web platform and includes test scripts for smoke/audio/sample/host-route checks, showing this is an executed DSH web plugin.
Repository tree includes lib/, tests/, and audit scripts, indicating runtime code plus validation for effects, actions, and triggers.
